h4_opening_cross.definition: Official opening cross on the listing venue (statistics stat_type 1: price and matched shares). An order is feasible when it is at least one whole share and at most 5% of the cross. account: 2.5% of a $50,000 account in whole shares at the official open. replay: the account order capped at 0.1% of the prior 20-session split-adjusted venue ADV, the frozen replay's sizing. The closing cross is read the same way for the cover.

h2_passive_offer_under_ssr.definition: Restricted sessions (cached Nasdaq SSR state at the entry open): a short-sale offer of the modeled size rests at the listing-venue best offer from the first valid book at or after 1s past the scheduled open, judged within 15 minutes. Fills only from buyer-initiated prints at or above the offer after the displayed queue ahead is consumed; the offer is re-priced above the bid whenever the bid reaches it. Unrestricted sessions are run the same way as a comparison only.

h3_participation_cost.definition: Sell by taking a fixed share of every continuous listing-venue print from the first valid book after the open for 60 minutes; cover the same way over the last 60 minutes with any residual at the official closing print. Fill prices are the print prices. Cost = (entry arrival mid - sell VWAP) + (buy VWAP - exit arrival mid) + crossing fraction x the volume-weighted half-spread at the fill times, all over the entry arrival mid. capacity: the order is the rate times the window's printed volume. account_*: a fixed order of 2.5% of the account at the arrival mid; completion within the window is reported.

schedules.fixed: The frozen replay's schedule: $0.005 per share, $1.00 minimum, capped at 1% of the leg's notional.
schedules.tiered: IBKR Pro tiered at the lowest volume tier: $0.0035 per share, $0.35 minimum, capped at 1% of the leg's notional, plus a $0.0030 per share exchange fee when removing liquidity, a $0.0020 per share rebate when adding liquidity (passive fills only, and only when the fill model fills) and $0.00020 per share clearing.

commissions.regulatory: SEC Section 31 at $27.80 per million of sell notional and FINRA TAF at $0.000166 per share sold (max $8.3); identical under both schedules and reported separately

H4.assessment: Kill criterion met on validation: only 24.3% of events support the account order at 5% of the cross.

definitions.short_return_convention: 1 - exit price / entry price; positive means the short gained.
definitions.split: By the entry session date. Train 2018-05-01 to 2022-12-31, validate 2023-01-01 to 2024-12-31, holdout from 2025-01-01 (sealed).
definitions.issuer_interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 whole-issuer (CIK) bootstrap draws; events of one issuer move together.
definitions.feasible_share: Share of events whose order is at least one whole share and at most 5% of the matched cross shares.
definitions.fill_rate: Share of simulated orders fully filled within 15 minutes of placement; partial fills are reported separately.
definitions.adverse_selection_5m: Midpoint five minutes after completion minus the fill price, over the arrival midpoint; positive is adverse to the short.
definitions.round_trip_cost: Entry shortfall + exit shortfall + crossing fraction x volume-weighted half-spread at the fill times, over the entry arrival midpoint; positive is a cost.
definitions.benchmark_minus_cost: The same events' official open-to-close gross short return minus the round-trip cost; H3's kill branch reads this below zero.
definitions.commission_fraction: Round-trip commission, venue fees and clearing (regulatory pass-through excluded) over the entry notional.

limits: Listing-venue books and prints only: not consolidated NBBO or consolidated volume; the queue model sees displayed size only, so hidden and midpoint liquidity ahead of the order is invisible and fill rates are upper bounds in that respect.

Cancellations cannot be attributed to a queue position; the primary model assumes they sit behind the order and bounds the queue ahead by the displayed size, the pro-rata variant is reported beside it.

The participation model follows printed volume with no market impact beyond the spread-crossing term; at 5% of volume that is optimistic and the cost curve across rates reflects timing and capacity only.

Arrival is the first valid book at or after one second past the scheduled open; the official opening print is the auction, not the first continuous book, and the timing difference is reported separately.
Halts inside a window simply contribute no prints; LULD and news halts are not modeled as events.
Commission schedules are declared constants (IBKR fixed and tiered at the lowest tier with representative exchange fees); regulatory pass-through uses today's published rates for every year.
The opening-cross feasibility is a size test at the printed price; it does not establish that an auction order of that size would not have moved the cross price.
No borrow, locate or margin assumption enters any number here; H2's realized return to the close is gross of borrow and commissions.
Holdout results exist only under local/holdout and were not read while writing this document; nothing here was selected on them.
